copy.title: Sleep tripwire (no reward)
copy.subtitle: No reward. A guard-only session: a warning sound plays when the sleep score crosses your personal threshold. Staged calibration, not skippable.
copy.guideText:
Reward: none. No reward sounds play.
Guard: default scorer ai.a_vig (Spur A: frozen CBraMod encoder + A-vig head, value = P(hypnagogic)), scored once per second over a rolling 2 s raw-EEG window. A warning sounds while the score is above the warning threshold (default: 75th percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution). The fixed frontal-delta ceiling does not trigger warnings in this program; time above it is only recorded as a signal-quality flag. This program requires the AI model: there is no band.delta fallback, and Start asks to install or load the model when it is not ready. The guard can be set to another installed AI scorer in the guard settings.
Calibration: staged and required (cannot be skipped): artifacts (blink, jaw clench), eyes-open task, eyes-closed rest. The rest stage sets the warning threshold.
The score is a statistical estimate. False alarms and missed sleep onsets are possible; this is not a safety device.

copy.title: Alpha over Theta (ATR), eyes closed, sleep guard
copy.subtitle: Rewards the alpha ÷ theta ratio (ATR) with the eyes closed. A sleep guard warns and muffles the reward when the sleep score crosses your threshold.
copy.guideText:
Reward: ATR = alpha ÷ theta on the target electrode pair (Muse AF7/AF8, Crown PO3/PO4), once per second. The reward fires while the value is above a percentile of your calibration distribution; the threshold adapts during the session (dynamic adapt).
Guard: default scorer ai.a_vig (Spur A: frozen CBraMod encoder + A-vig head, value = P(hypnagogic)), scored once per second over a rolling 2 s raw-EEG window. A warning sounds while the score is above the warning threshold (default: 75th percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution). The fixed frontal-delta ceiling does not trigger warnings in this program; time above it is only recorded as a signal-quality flag. Without a ready AI model the guard falls back to band.delta (frontal delta against the same percentile rule). The guard can be switched off or set to another installed scorer in the guard settings. During a warning the reward output is muffled.
Calibration: staged (artifacts, eyes-open task, eyes-closed rest) when an AI guard runs, otherwise a single eyes-closed baseline.

copy.title: Beta over Theta (BTR), eyes open
copy.subtitle: Rewards the beta ÷ theta ratio (BTR) with the eyes open, against an eyes-open baseline. No sleep guard.
copy.guideText:
Reward: BTR = beta ÷ theta on the target electrode pair (Muse AF7/AF8, Crown PO3/PO4), once per second. The reward fires while the value is above a percentile of your calibration distribution; the threshold adapts during the session (dynamic adapt).
Guard: none.
Calibration: single eyes-open baseline (staged only when Settings → AI Calibration is set to always staged).
Eyes-open signal carries more blink and muscle artifact; contaminated samples are gated out.

copy.title: Staged calibration, then quiet recording
copy.subtitle: Runs the full staged calibration (artifacts, eyes-open task, eyes-closed rest), then records with no reward, guard or feedback sounds. Calibration cannot be skipped.
copy.guideText:
Calibration: staged and required (cannot be skipped): artifacts (blink, jaw clench), eyes-open task, eyes-closed rest.
After calibration: recording only. No reward, no guard, no feedback sounds.
Each stage's quiet recording window (start and end of the silent part after its prompt), its stage id (artifacts, eyes-open clear, eyes-closed rest) and eyes state are written to the session's calibration metadata, so the artifact, eyes-open and eyes-closed segments can be cut from the raw EEG later. Prompt timings and spoken text are recorded as well.

Every enabled stream (EEG, bands, PPG, pulse, IMU, movement, peak alpha, telemetry) is written to the session file.
